originStory.title: Why I Built This System
originStory.subtitle: From AI frustration to something that actually works
originStory.story: Like you, I was frustrated. `ChatGPT`, `Claude`, `Gemini`. I tried them all. Same result every time: generic output that didn't sound like me. I'd spend more time editing than if I'd written from scratch. Then I realized the problem wasn't AI. It was that I hadn't taught AI who I am, how I write, or what my content is about. So I built a system for training AI to understand my voice, my style, my business. Now I use it daily, and I'm sharing it with you.
originStory.inspirationPoint: I realized the problem wasn't AI. It was that nobody taught me how to train it properly.
